calculator.cutoff_rule: 31 December of the year immediately preceding the examination year
relaxation_categories_summary: Scheduled Castes and Buddhist community, with the prescribed certificate
Recognized tribes who are permanent residents of the areas specified in the CSS rules
Permanent residents of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, with the prescribed certificate
Permanent residents of Gilgit-Baltistan, with the prescribed certificate
Specified persons with disabilities, with the prescribed disability certificate
In-service government servants and armed-forces personnel with at least two years of continuous service by the cut-off date, subject to the rules

education.minimum: At least a second-division or Grade C bachelor's degree, or an equivalent qualification recognized by HEC
education.third_division_exception: A third-division/Grade D bachelor's holder may be eligible if they have obtained a higher division or grade in a master's degree

calculator.nationality: Citizen of Pakistan or a person deriving nationality from the State of Jammu and Kashmir
calculator.mandatory_disclaimer: This calculator provides preliminary guidance only. Candidates must verify eligibility from the latest FPSC rules and examination advertisement.

application_checklist: Read the latest CSS/MPT advertisement and applicable rules.
Confirm age, qualification, nationality, domicile and any relaxation claim.
Complete the online application within the notified period.
Pay the prescribed fee through the method stated in the current advertisement.
Select optional subjects in accordance with the official group restrictions.
Review names, CNIC details, date of birth, domicile, subjects and centre before submission.
Save the submitted application, fee proof and tracking information.
Submit a hard copy only when the current CSS advertisement expressly requires it.
document_checklist: Printed online application, when required by the current advertisement
Matriculation certificate showing date of birth
Master's degree and transcript/DMC, if relied upon for eligibility
HEC equivalence certificate for a foreign or equivalent qualification, where applicable
Recent photographs in the number and format stated in the advertisement
Departmental Permission Certificate/NOC for eligible government servants, where applicable
Certificate supporting an age-relaxation claim, where applicable
Any additional document required in the current advertisement
